Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation today — great to learn more about Acme Analytics' ingestion pipeline and the latency constraints you mentioned. Quick recap and suggested next steps:

- Attendees we recommend: your data platform lead + one infra engineer; I’ll bring Dylan (SE) and Connor (solutions lead) if useful.
- Pre-read: attached a short demo plan (redwood-demo-plan.pdf) with agenda and a couple quick benchmarks.

Can we lock a time for the demo? My availability this week:
- Tue Jul 21: 10:00–11:00 AM PDT

If neither works, happy to propose a tighter window — we’ve found customers prefer a narrowly defined 30-min slot to reduce back-and-forth. If you can reply with a single confirmed slot, I’ll send a calendar invite + invite Dylan.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
